items.item: The form is split into titled sections (personal, job and contract, bank and tax, emergency contact, documents) in a single column, with a visible label above every field and no placeholder-only labels
items.evidence: sections array renders h2 'Personal details', 'Job & contract', 'Bank & tax', 'Emergency contact', plus section#documents 'Documents'. renderField puts label (display:block) above every input; no placeholder attributes. Single column except two short pairs (first/last name, city/postal) in a sm:grid-cols-2 row.

items.item: Required fields are marked consistently, and optional fields are labelled as optional or left unmarked by a stated convention
items.evidence: Required labels get ' *' and the page states '* Required fields' under the title; optional fields (Preferred name, Date of birth, Work email) are unmarked under that stated convention. Conditional endDate becomes required when Fixed-term (help text says so).

items.item: Field widths match their content: dates, postal codes and tax codes are narrow; inputs use the right types (email, tel, date)
items.evidence: birthDate/startDate max-w-[180px], postal max-w-[140px], routing max-w-[240px], SSN max-w-sm (narrower than full width, wider than ideal). type=email, tel, date are used; salary type=number; account/SSN type=password with Show toggle.

items.item: An option to save the form as a draft is offered, and saving a draft does not demand every required field
items.evidence: Footer button #save-draft 'Save draft'; save(draft) only runs fields.forEach(validate) when !draft, so a draft skips required validation.

items.item: Save and Cancel stay reachable while scrolling (a sticky bar or equivalent), Save is a verb label and is not disabled before submitting
items.evidence: <footer class='sticky bottom-0 ...'> holds Cancel, Save draft, 'Save employee' (visible in the 1440x900 screenshot); buttons are only disabled inside busy(true) while saving, not beforehand.

items.item: Fields validate on blur and on submit; with several errors a summary at the top links to each field and focus moves to the first invalid field
items.evidence: Each field has a blur listener calling validate(f); submit runs fields.forEach(validate), then summary() builds #error-summary ('N fields need attention') with <a href='#id' data-focus> links when 3 or more errors, and $(invalid[0].id).focus() moves focus. Summary click handler focuses the target field.

items.item: Leaving the page with unsaved input triggers a warning
items.evidence: window.addEventListener('beforeunload', ...) fires when dirty; in-app Cancel and navigation go through guard() which opens the 'Leave without saving?' dialog.

items.item: The document upload states accepted file types and the size limit, lists chosen files with a remove button, and is keyboard operable
items.evidence: #upload-help: 'PDF, JPG, or PNG · Up to 10 MB per file'; docRender lists each file with a button aria-label='Remove <name>' (data-remove); a real <button id='browse'> triggers the sr-only file input (aria-describedby upload-help); addFiles rejects wrong type or over-size with a message.

items.item: Success is confirmed with a message that names the employee and is announced to assistive technology
items.evidence: showToast(`Olivia Bennett · Employee EMP-0248 saved`) built from values.firstName/lastName, rendered into #toast role='status' (pre-existing live region); #save-state role='status' also updates 'Saved hh:mm'.

notes: Clean, restrained HR form: flat white and slate palette, 4px radii, no gradient, glass, emoji or KPI tiles. Audit score 100. Minor: error summary only appears for 3 or more errors (fewer are shown inline with focus moved to the first). The JL initials avatar is a real person (Jamie Lee), so not a tell. Page uses a demo-only simulated save.
